## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender, and stylish woman with a thin body and milk-white skin paired with pink cheeks. Her pointed, freckled face features seven freckles specifically noted on her nose, and her hair is glossy, red, and tumbled, sometimes worn in long braids or described as auburn and [Titian](../character/titian.md). Her expressive eyes are solemn, luminous, and serious, appearing gray or shining gray-green. They are described as alluring as evening stars and capable of looking radiant alongside her pale, ever-changing complexion.

## Personality

Anne is a deeply imaginative and dreamy individual who maintains a strong appreciation for home. Though known to be heedless and impulsive at times, she is also smart, obedient, and possesses a compassionate, empathetic nature along with a deep affection for children. Politically, she considers herself a red-hot [Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative) out of loyalty to Matthew's memory. Throughout her youth, she was motivated to excel in her examinations for [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and Marilla's sake, ultimately resolving to win the Avery scholarship, while retaining a lifelong desire to add beauty to life. She is skilled in reciting, gardening, and writing stories, particularly those written for children.

## History

Anne grew up as an unloved orphan girl, moving between homes and working as a drudge until [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) adopted her from an asylum and brought her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Early on, she faced near-expulsion from the home after falsely confessing to taking Marilla's brooch to attend a picnic, and she temporarily quit school after smashing a slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head when he called her 'Carrots.' Her trajectory shifted when she saved the life of [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's sister, earning back her best friend, and later tied with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) during the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) passed away, Anne gave up her college scholarship to remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach school, raise Marilla's orphaned distant twin relatives, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and co-found the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). After eventually pursuing higher education at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she rejected a rich suitor, Royal Gardner, realizing her true feelings lay with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), whom she accepted after he recovered from typhoid fever. The couple married at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and moved to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), where Anne survived the tragic death of her firstborn infant, Joyce, before giving birth to a healthy son, [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md). Overcoming her grief, she formed deep bonds with her neighbors, including [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Captain Jim, whose life story she helped inspire into a published book before his peaceful passing. The family subsequently relocated to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, where Anne successfully raised six children while offering guidance to the town and defending the lively children of the local minister, Mr. Meredith.

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Anne first met the minister's wife, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), when baking a layer cake to welcome her to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), though the visit turned chaotic after Anne mistakenly used anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) treated the mistake with immense kindness and grace, forming an immediate bond. Over the years, they grew into close kindred spirits who share deep confidences, write simple prose together, and offer emotional support in times of grief.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) was Anne's mother, who died alongside her husband when Anne was just a baby. For most of her life, Anne only knew her mother through tragic stories of her orphanhood. Years later, Anne visited her parents' home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) and received a collection of old love letters written by Bertha, finally allowing her to feel a deep personal connection to her deceased mother.

- Child of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--di.md)

[Di](../character/di.md) is one of Anne's daughters who plays with the local children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). She is a loyal friend to her playmates, notably defending [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) alongside her twin sister [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) when [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) criticized Faith's behavior.

- Friend of — close friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), +6 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/di.md) became Anne's devoted bosom friend shortly after Anne arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Their early friendship faced major drama when Anne accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana's mother to temporarily forbid them from seeing each other. After Anne saved Diana's baby sister from croup, their bond was permanently cemented, and they have remained affectionate confidantes through school, romance, and marriage.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +47 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Anne began as bitter classroom rivals after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulled her hair and called her 'Carrots,' prompting Anne to hold an unforgiving grudge for years. Their intense academic rivalry eventually gave way to close friendship as they attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) together. Over time, their dynamic shifted from academic comrades to romantic partners, culminating in their marriage and shared family at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) and [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside).
